Proof in the paper: The patterns of the calcined samples (Figure 1b) show three primary reflections at around 2θ = 36°, 43.5°, and 63°, indicating the structure of Ni–Mg–Al mixed oxides. In the case of Pt-added hydrotalcite-derived catalysts, some reflections could be observed at around 38°, 46.5°, and 68°, corresponding to the (111), (200), and (220) planes for Pt phase.
